name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Either Wrenna goes with 53 gp or 63 gp goes with Transmutation.
58 gp goes with exactly one of Mara, Abjuration, or Illusion.
If 48 gp does not go with Transmutation, then Kael goes with Conjuration.
Either 63 gp goes with Lyra or Necromancy goes with Mara.
The Illusion mage's gold is higher than both Wrenna and the Conjuration mage.
53 gp, 63 gp, and 68 gp go with Kael, Illusion, and Necromancy, in some order.
